cross_product_finding: This Capella page repeatedly gates Search Service features (custom doc_filter, the bm25 scoring_model, default_synonym_source) behind inline 'Couchbase Server 8.0' markers, even though the batch background states Capella has no discrete version numbers exposed to users. This indicates the underlying managed cluster's Couchbase Server version still determines Search Service feature availability, and this cloud/ page appears to reuse server/-authored version-gating prose verbatim rather than translating it into a Capella-native availability concept (e.g. a release-train or 'available on newly created clusters' label). I minted version:server-8.0 here to capture this literal textual gate, but flagging for the coordinator: this may need to be modeled differently from the registry's version:server-6.5/7.0 concepts, which were presumably minted to describe Capella's OWN versioning (which per the background doesn't really exist) - here the version literally belongs to the underlying Couchbase Server, referenced FROM a Capella page. Two different things wearing the same shirt.
